title: SPX-VIX Risk Computations Via Perturbed Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2603.10857v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a model independent framework for generating SPX and VIX risk scenarios based on a joint optimal transport calibration of their market smiles. Starting from the entropic martingale optimal transport formulation of Guyon, we introduce a perturbation methodology that computes sensitivities of the calibrated coupling using a Fisher information linearization. This allows risk to be generated without performing a full recalibration after market shocks. We further introduce a dimension reduction method based on perturbed optimal transport that produces fast and stable risk estimates while preserving the structural properties of the calibrated model. The approach is combined with Skew Stickiness Ratio(SSR) dynamics to translate SPX shocks into perturbations of forward variance and VIX distributions. translated_title: 基于扰动最优传输的SPX-VIX风险计算
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个模型无关的框架，用于基于SPX和VIX市场微笑曲线的联合最优传输校准来生成SPX和VIX风险情景。从Guyon的熵鞅最优传输公式出发，我们引入了一种扰动方法，利用Fisher信息线性化来计算校准耦合的敏感度。这使得在市场冲击发生后无需进行完整的重新校准即可生成风险。我们进一步引入了一种基于扰动最优传输的降维方法，在保持校准模型结构性质的同时，能够产生快速且稳定的风险估计。该方法与偏度粘性比率（SSR）动力学相结合，将SPX冲击转化为远期方差和VIX分布的扰动。数值实验表明，所提出的方法相对于完整重新校准能够产生准确的风险估计，同时具有更高的计算效率。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于扰动最优传输的模型无关框架，利用Fisher信息线性化计算校准耦合的敏感度，并结合SSR动力学，在市场冲击后无需完整重新校准即可快速准确地生成SPX和VIX的风险情景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-independent framework based on perturbed optimal transport, which uses Fisher information linearization to compute sensitivities of the calibrated coupling and combines SSR dynamics to generate fast and accurate SPX-VIX risk scenarios without full recalibration after market shocks.
